components.name: Button
components.summary: Buttons run one action.

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: A keyboard shortcut, set in mono.

components.name: Input
components.summary: A single-line text field.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: The only shape rule in Workbus: people are round, agents are square.

components.name: SeatState
components.summary: A seat's live state: a small mark and its name in mono.

components.name: Kind
components.summary: The kind of an inbox item or held task, set in mono on a tint.

components.name: Label
components.summary: A typed label from the board (project=launch, priority=high), set in mono with a hairline border.

components.name: HeldPill
components.summary: The status pill for a thread or task held for you, shown in the thread pane's facts row.

components.name: TaskState
components.summary: The task state glyph, 14px, at the start of every task row and on board cards: ready (a ring), claimed (a half-filled agent ring), held (a vermilion ring with…

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: The faces of a thread (Conversation, Task, Doc) and the sections of a seat doc.

components.name: SidebarItem
components.summary: A row in the sidebar: Inbox, My work, agents with their state, teams and channels.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: A context or overflow menu.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.summary: ⌘K runs commands, searches seats, threads and docs, and sends anything that isn't a command to the operator (§9.3).

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A short confirmation of what you just did, with its log position and, where it can be reversed, Undo.

components.name: NewEventsPill
components.summary: Live updates never move what you're reading.

components.name: IssueRow
components.summary: A row in an issue list, a queue or a saved view: cursor, state, title, kinds and labels, assignee, updated.

components.name: BoardCard
components.summary: A task on a board grouped by state.

components.name: Message
components.summary: One event in a thread: avatar, name, mono handle, and time at the right.

components.name: ToolCall
components.summary: A tool call an agent made, inside its message: the tool's name, its status, and its input as compact JSON in mono on raised.

components.name: ApprovalCard
components.summary: The answer to a held task, inline in the thread under the message that asked.
